replies.author: Zedther
replies.body:
The map is extremely flat, and the random structures aren't exactly making a difference.
I'd highly suggest adding elevation as well as archer towers and far better and more enclosed spawn locations. I feel as though people are going to glitch on the side and potentially spawn camp or prolong the game. Aesthetic-wise, it doesn't have much going for it.

overall a decent map at best, but just needs some work.

Keep it up, Pal.

replies.author: Xuph
replies.body:
I am sorry to say but your map, Pixeleon, has been denied from testing for the Avicus Network.

To Improve your map, the map developers suggest you to add more structures, less repetitive pattern/block structures, more block variation.

I personally suggest you editing the shape, more structures as well and just spice it up a bit.

If you have any other questions on how to improve your map, Find me on TeamSpeak or Message me on Skype (eric_mcgamer).


You may resubmit your map once edited.
